title: Jesus... I Told Amma I’m Busy. I’m Not.
topic: told his mother he is too busy to come home for Diwali when really he does not want her to see how his year went

bible.text: Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... Amma asked me to come home for Diwali. I said I’m busy. I’m not. 📱

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I booked nothing. I just didn’t want her to see how this year went.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You told Me the year went badly. Did you think she couldn’t carry that too?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: She’ll ask why I look thinner. What do I tell her?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tell her the truth. She raised you on harder sentences than that.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Honor isn’t a perfect report card. It’s showing up before the lamps are lit.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When did you last just show up at home? 👇
